title: Transcriptomic profiles revealed down regulation of low-density lipoprotein particle receptor activity pathway in survived from severe COVID-19-19.
description: This submission contains a result of a study of transcriptiomic profiles of blood of COVID-19 patients. Overall design: Examination of transcriptiomic profiles of the blood, derived from surviving and deceased COVID-19 patients.
